Dear Shankar dada,
I'm writing this because when I try to say it, you walk off.
Yesterday I was humming while doing my geometry, and you shouted, "Shut up! Can't you ever stop?" so loudly that Maa came running. I didn't know what I'd done. I felt about five years old.
Later Maa told me your physics exam went badly. I get it now. I'd be upset too.
But understanding why doesn't make it okay. I was only humming. I'd like you to say sorry, and next time just tell me you've had a bad day. I'll give you space.
Your brother,
Madhav
